name: x
description: Read-only access to the X API — search posts and users, read timelines and mentions, and pull trends and news — via X's official hosted MCP server.

X_BEARER_TOKEN.title: X app-only Bearer token
X_BEARER_TOKEN.description: App-only Bearer token from your app's Keys and tokens page in the X Developer Portal (https://developer.x.com). Grants read-only access to the X API with no user context.
